The parent depends on this row and cannot be planned until it lands. Read parent comment-202b1b9680924f66bd28ebd02acea17c and the parent's re-measurement comment for the full premise.

WHY THIS ROW EXISTS, measured at HEAD 2026-09-02, root D:/projexts/moe-next, branch moe/work-2026-09-02.
`tests/e2e/control-room/daemon-scratch.ts` has exactly TEN importers. Nine are inside the parent's owned ten-path set; the tenth, `tests/e2e/control-room/gate1-v1-approval.spec.ts` (260 lines), is OUTSIDE it and imports six symbols at :9-11:

    import {
      LANE_CREDENTIAL, LANE_CSRF_TOKEN, createLaneScratch, daemonEnv, repoRoot, seedEnv,
    } from "./daemon-scratch.js";

The parent's DoD item 2 requires daemon-scratch.ts DELETED, which breaks that file. Retiring the module in one row needs ELEVEN distinct paths (nine owned importers + daemon-scratch.ts + gate1). moe.submit_plan hard-rejects past ten: `.moe/project.json` `settings` has NO `taskSizing` key, so `MAX_DISTINCT_FILES_DEFAULT = 10` applies (daemon `util/planSize.js:17`), and `assessPlanSize` counts the union of `affectedFiles` AND `newFiles` across every step (`tools/submitPlan.js:229`), so `newFiles` is not an escape hatch. Eleven is refused by the daemon itself.

This row removes the eleventh path by re-pointing gate1 FIRST. The parent then has exactly nine importers left plus the module, fits ten, and deletes it with its DoD intact and unamended.

SCOPE — EXACTLY TWO PATHS, and the shape is deliberately minimal:
  1. `tests/e2e/control-room/daemon-ports.ts` — add ONE re-export line for the six symbols gate1 needs, using the `export { … } from "./…js";` form the file already uses at :34 (`export { survivingPids } from "./daemon-children.js";`). daemon-ports.ts ALREADY value-imports all six at :29-31, so this re-exports what it holds; it does not add an import edge.
  2. `tests/e2e/control-room/gate1-v1-approval.spec.ts` — swap that one import specifier to `./daemon-ports.js`. Symbol names and types are unchanged; this is a specifier swap, not a rewrite.

FORBIDDEN IN THIS ROW, because the parent owns them: do NOT delete or empty daemon-scratch.ts, do NOT move any helper implementation, do NOT re-point any of the other nine importers, do NOT create a new module. Copying a helper body into daemon-ports.ts is a second authority and is the failure this shape exists to avoid — see Serena `decision-e2e-scratch-retirement-keeps-one-harness-authority`.

LINE CAP IS NOT A CONSTRAINT HERE and the parent's Ground 2 does not carry: the 250/400 cap is PER PRODUCTION FILE (project rail 2, human-confirmed), daemon-ports.ts has zero non-test import edges, and its own tier already carries 630/562/438/410-line siblings under tests/e2e. This row adds ~1 line to a 322-line test-tier harness regardless.

All eleven paths measured CLEAN (`git status --porcelain` empty) at filing time.
